content.short: TAND3M is a TON launchpad for transparent token and NFT sales using fixed-price rounds and LBPs.
content.description: TAND3M is a decentralized launchpad built on TON. Its docs and TON App listing describe token sales, NFT offerings, fixed-price rounds, and liquidity bootstrapping pools for fair price discovery. The platform focuses on transparent fundraising, audited smart-contract sales, Telegram Mini App access, and broker-supported project credibility. Tand3m: Tand3m - The next generation of Tand3m. For TON teams, the value is less about end-user trading and more about helping projects reach users, capital, or market visibility.
